comments_data.body: Thanks @lilitkarapetyan - but I think we need a confirm dialog to delete the asset after clicking the red x, please.

Thanks @lilitkarapetyan! Could you make the X dark grey and center it on the asset? It'd look something like this: 

![Asset Delete Feature](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/158176360-ec7f1ddc-1166-4927-8d69-7e44adee9483.png)

As you can see, the selected asset has a slightly lighter grey to bring it into focus since the asset selection background is navy blue.
Just checked out the deployment. Looks much better!

@lilitkarapetyan - I think that the change to the formatting for `List of assets` in this PR broke the display of `asset-icons` in the top-left panel:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/159659771-69795de9-6fc1-4801-be0a-8f7ff440f299.png)

issues.title: Drag & Drop Not Intuitive
issues.body:
As a user, it might not be intuitive for me to have to drag back an asset into the asset list if I mistakenly added it:

![Not Intuitive Drag And Drop](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85491794/156879677-48332e2c-bf8f-43f3-8937-938d13302cb8.png)
 
Could we provide a small X on the right of the asset like with deletable chips?

comments.body:
@lilitkarapetyan - could you have a think about the options for deleting an asset from the list of assets?

Is it possible to have a small `x` at the top-right of the asset icon, to delete it?
